title: Working with ArrayList
description:
Complete the methods:

```java
static List<Integer> withoutDuplicates(List<Integer> values)        // a new list, first occurrences kept, in order
static void removeNegatives(List<Integer> values)                   // changes the given list in place
static List<String> longWords(List<String> words, int minLength)    // words with at least minLength letters, upper-cased
static List<Integer> positionsOf(List<String> items, String target) // every index where target appears (equals)
static double average(List<Integer> values)                         // 0.0 for an empty list; null items are skipped
```
hints: Removing while an enhanced `for` walks the list throws `ConcurrentModificationException`. Go backwards with an index instead, so removing does not shift the items still to visit.
Compare strings with `equals`; the test passes a `new String("cake")`, which is a different object from the one in the list.
